{{Top|leg}}
The '''Neimoidian kreehawk''' was a black-feathered, predatory avian native to the forests of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. These large creatures had smooth sloping heads with reflective eyes that allowed them to see even in near darkness. They had razor-sharp talons and their massive wingspan was covered in black feathers that made it seem nearly the size of a small [[Human/Legends|Human]]. Despite this being the case, kreehawks had the potential to reach great speeds and were extremely nimble animals.

A quarter of kreehawks were kept in the aviary of [[Darga Jiramma Mionne|Darga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. These birds were trained to respond to Darga personally, but could also be controlled using a command whistle. Darga's kreehawks could attack on command, and were capable of killing and completely devouring a victim's remains.
